I'm just passing on this information." (0:25). The channel's track record: "These have been a best seller on my channel since July" (5:29).

## Reassurance and shame
- Reassurance: "You may like some of these trends, you may not, and that's okay." (0:28); "if you own a beautiful classic loafer, there's absolutely no reason to stop wearing it" (9:08); "good news, if you do, keep wearing it" (23:11, the Paige boot); the close at 26:09.
- Could read as shaming: "Wear a shoe style that died 3 years ago." (0:02); "These are the boots that are going to ruin your fall look for 2026." (17:28); "If you're not doing any of those activities, do not wear those shoes." (11:52). Nothing aimed at age or other women.
